subject: Coord: Quantify onsite visit — dates, stakeholders, and procurement items
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Megan Park <megan@quantify.ai>, procurement@quantify.ai
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite: Quantify office visit — proposed dates & stakeholders

Hi Megan / Quantify procurement team,

Thanks for the chat last week — excited to move toward an onsite visit so we can run the end-to-end inference demo and validate networking/security assumptions in your environment. To get the calendar planned, proposed windows we have available for a half-day demo + stakeholder sync are:

- Tue/Wed March 9–10 (SF)
- Tue/Wed March 23–24 (SF)

Can you confirm which range works better for your engineering and procurement teams? We’ll plan for:

- AE + SE: Jonas (AE) + Dylan (SE) from Redwood
- Security/compliance: invite (SOC2 summary attached)
- Procurement: finalize SOW/invoicing items
- Exec dinner: target evening of the first day (optional, execs only)

I attached a quick venue options spreadsheet and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review. If you prefer an on-site at your office, note any AV/room capacity needs and we’ll adjust the agenda.

Next steps: please reply with preferred date window and attendees; I’ll send a provisional calendar invite and draft agenda.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
From: Megan Park <megan@quantify.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantify.ai, security@quantify.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite: Quantify office visit — proposed dates & stakeholders

Thanks Jonas — March 23–24 works better for our leads (we have product kickoff earlier in March).

Quick notes from our side:
- I will loop in Liza (procurement) and our security lead (security@quantify.ai) — they need the draft SOW and SOC2 summary.
- For the demo, our infra/eng leads want a half-day deep dive (model serving, network/firewalls, and data retention controls). Can Dylan bring example traffic/latency numbers and a short checklist for our infra team?
- Exec dinner: we’re available evening of Tue 23rd; would prefer somewhere near SOMA.

Cc’ing Liza and security. Please share the calendar invite when you have a provisional time.

Cheers,
Megan
Senior Platform Engineer, Quantify Analytics
megan@quantify.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Megan Park <megan@quantify.ai>, Liza Kim <liza.kim@quantify.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite: Quantify office visit — proposed dates & stakeholders

Sounds good — locking in Tue/Wed March 23–24.

Dylan — can you confirm you and one SE have availability those two days and are OK to bring the latency/throughput slides + a short runbook for cutover scenarios?

Liza — attached: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf (high level), SOC2-summary.pdf. If procurement needs an NDA or redlines before the SOW, flag them and we’ll coordinate with legal. Also adding a venue options sheet in case you prefer an external dinner.

Proposed onsite agenda (draft):
- Day 1 (Mar 23): 09:00–12:30 technical deep dive (eng + infra), 13:30–15:00 joint product sync, 19:00 exec dinner (SOMA)
- Day 2 (Mar 24): 09:00–11:30 integration checklist + next steps, 11:30–12:30 procurement wrap / SOW sign-off

Action items:
- Liza: confirm procurement contact and any billing/PO requirements
- Security: can you confirm an on-site contact and whether you need a pre-demo attestation?
- Dylan: confirm SE attendee list & materials

If nothing urgent, I’ll send a placeholder calendar invite later today for the 23rd (all-day) and update times as details land.

Thanks — Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Liza Kim <liza.kim@quantify.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Megan Park <megan@quantify.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantify.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite: Quantify office visit — proposed dates & stakeholders

Thanks Jonas — March 23–24 is fine from procurement standpoint. A few procurement items to call out:

- We need a finalized SOW and our standard attachment to the PO; redlines should be returned by EOD Mon 2/16 to meet our internal processing for a March invoice.
- Quantify requires a vendor W-9 and an invoice sample in the vendor portal; can you send those?
- NDAs: We typically require a mutual NDA prior to any exec dinner that will include non-public roadmap discussion. If Redwood has a standard mutual NDA, please attach; otherwise we can share ours.

On security: our security lead (security@quantify.ai) is cc’d; they’ve asked for the SOC2 summary and a short list of network ports used by your runtime. If you can provide that prior to the on-site (even a bullet list), it will speed the pre-demo checklist.

Exec dinner: Tue 23rd evening at 19:00 looks good. Please propose two venue options — casual is fine (SOMA restaurants OK).

--
Liza Kim
Senior Procurement Manager, Quantify Analytics
liza.kim@quantify.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Megan Park <megan@quantify.ai>, Liza Kim <liza.kim@quantify.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, security@quantify.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite: Quantify office visit — final calendar & materials

Thanks everyone — confirming the plan and next steps: March 23–24 onsite at Quantify (we’ll meet at your SOMA office unless you prefer alternate venue).

Quick checklist we completed and links:
- Calendar provisional invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=quantify-onsite-20260323
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/QNTFY-2026-87
- Shared agenda & parking/AV notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BexampleAgenda

Attachments included in this thread: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf (for procurement), Quantify_venue-options.xlsx (dinner options), SOC2-summary.pdf (security).

Operational notes for Dylan: please prepare:
- Latency/throughput deck (10 slides) and live traffic sample (if possible)
- Network port list (allowed outbound ports, any firewall considerations)
- Quick rollback plan for model switch (bullet points)

Procurement note for Liza: I’ll send the W-9 & invoice sample to procurement@quantify.ai by EOD Monday. If you prefer us to upload to a vendor portal, point me at the link.

Megan / Liza — if you confirm the 19:00 Tue dinner (I’ll book two options), I’ll have Marissa follow up with logistics and a final attendee list for the exec table.

Appreciate the quick alignment — looking forward to the visit.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf; Quantify_venue-options.xlsx; SOC2-summary.pdf
